svg.text: UCAN V1.0 — what to change on C1, C2 and BH (top side, USB on the left)
Simplified redraw after FYSETC's component-position drawing. Pad labels are printed on the bottom side; confirm every pad with the meter.
R1 + R2 (59 Ω each, ≈118 Ω terminator, on by default): REMOVE on C1, C2, BH when H0 reads ≈118 Ω
R4 (10 kΩ pull-up on U1 pin 8): REMOVE if fitted; keep R18 (10 kΩ to GND)
JP1: leave open (no jumper) — R3 stays, it only acts when the jumper is fitted
Wire P2: CK on all; DO on C1 only; RES on C2/BH; button B0 ↔ 3V3 on all
Power plug on P3: 3V3 and G (adjacent pads at the end away from USB)
P1 order: read the print on your terminal (bottom side: CAN_L · CAN_H · GND)
